{{Quote|What's your situation?''"<br />"''What's it look like? We're pinned down!|Gavyn Sykes and Kol Kotha discuss their predicament|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
This '''mission''' took place during the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. After [[Capture of Theed/Legends|losing Naboo's capital]], the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Security Forces]] were overwhelmed, and a group of [[Naboo Underground|resistance]] fighters, led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]], began searching for allies in their struggle. Fighting their way through the countryside, two [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Skirmishes in the Naboo countryside|saved]] a [[Trading village (Naboo swamps)|trading village]] in the Naboo swamps, and the surviving [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] sent Kael and [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] on a mission to the mountains to find a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who could help them fight the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. Upon locating and rescuing the [[Borvo the Hutt's freighter|smuggler's transport]], the [[Officer/Legends|officers]] escorted it through the canyon while under constant fire from Trade Federation forces. The smuggling crew and [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] pilots fought through the canyon, and [[Borvo]], the smuggler, gratefully offered his assistance. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] led them toward his [[N-1 assembly site]] in the mountains, which came under attack by Federation forces. After they destroyed the attacking [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], Borvo gave the pilots new [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]] and aided in planning an [[Disruption of Comm 4|offensive]] against the [[Droid/Legends|Droid]] [[Army/Legends|Army]].

==Prelude==
After a disastrous defeat in the early stages of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] were forced into a desperate battle for survival. The Security Force [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]] and his wingmate [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] escaped the invasion and [[Skirmishes in the Naboo countryside|engaged]] Trade Federation forces attacking [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] civilians. The two [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] subsequently joined up with police officer [[Vedd Deviss]] after rescuing his [[Trading village (Naboo swamps)|trading village]]. Acting on intelligence provided by Deviss, Kael and Sykes headed with him into the northern mountains to search for a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], who could help them [[Attack on disabled base|strike back]] at the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|Great work, Officer. Follow me, I have something to show you.|The homestead owner, to Gavyn Sykes|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo}}
As the three pilots approached the mountains, they picked up a [[Borvo the Hutt's freighter|ship]], which, according to Deviss, belonged to their "smuggling friend." Kael advised his wingmates to stay alert just before a patrol of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] damaged Sykes' [[N-X Police Cruiser/Legends|N-X Police Cruiser]]. Due to the damage, Sykes switched to a [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|landspeeder]] acquired from a nearby [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. Kael and Deviss went to search for the smuggler on the north trail while Sykes went east. Sykes came across a civilian homestead under attack by [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]] and destroyed the [[Droid/Legends|droids]], saving the homestead's [[Unidentified Naboo homestead owner|owner]]. The owner gratefully gave Sykes technology to upgrade his vehicle.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />
{{Endgame}}

Sykes then continued his search for the smuggler. Kael ordered him to ignore several houses under attack by the Federation, as there were too many [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Squad/Legends|squads]] there. Traveling past the houses, Sykes found the smuggler's [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in a canyon pinned down by [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]]. He contacted the ship and offered his assistance. Scouting ahead, Sykes escorted the ship through the canyon, destroying many [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] firing at the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] along the way.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

Upon reaching a safe distance from the tanks, Borvo thanked Sykes for the assistance and offered his support, and the Naboo pilots agreed to travel with him. Sykes found another police cruiser in a hangar and took to the skies while Deviss landed and supported the group from the ground. Though Sykes was worried they might be heading into a trap, Kael assured him it was worth the risk. When they reached the Hutt's base, the [[N-1 assembly site]], they discovered that the Trade Federation was already there and planned to wipe out the base. Although the Federation had planted [[Mine/Legends|mines]] in the area, the pilots successfully escorted Borvo's ship to the base, destroying several [[Laser turret (Trade Federation)|laser turrets]] on the way. First, however, the ship had to stop at a staging area and allow [[Kol Kotha]], one of Borvo's pilots, the chance to join the fight in his [[Borvo the Hutt's starfighter|starfighter]]. Kotha then picked up a Federation transmission, letting them know that droid reinforcements were inbound. The pilots performed several strafing runs against the droids and destroyed the tanks before the base was wiped out.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Mission accomplished! The N-1 assembly site is now under our control.|Captain Kael, to his pilots, after the defeat of the Trade Federation|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
[[File:N-1_starfighter_factory.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The N-1 starfighter assembly area]]
With the factory saved and the pilots having acquired new ships, they went on to strike the [[Attack on disabled base|first blow]] against the Trade Federation invasion. Borvo provided information and material to the [[Naboo Underground|Naboo resistance]] until the Hutt [[Search for Captain Kael|betrayed]] them.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> Borvo was in the employ of the Trade Federation, and later provided information about the resistance to the invaders. The incident was later mentioned in a report given to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] by the leader of the invasion, [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]].<ref name="EG">{{StoryCite|story=End Game|book=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|bformatted=''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization, 2012 edition}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This mission is comprised of the events of the fourth and the fifth missions of the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. These missions introduce Borvo the Hutt and his crew, who went on to play an important role in later missions. In the first of these two missions, it is possible to defend a Naboo civilian, who in turn will lead the player to a bonus objective. In the second mission, the player has the option of staying in the speeder, in which case Vedd Deviss will remain in his NX-police cruiser.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> A storyboard of the fifth mission by artist [[James Zhang]] was also included in the 2008 behind-the-scenes book ''[[Rogue Leaders: The Story of LucasArts]]''.<ref name="Rogue Leaders">''[[Rogue Leaders: The Story of LucasArts]]''</ref>
